senses.gloss: चीन- + अंशुक चीन- + अंशुक, n. silk.

चिन्त् चिन्त् (akin to चित् and चि), i. 10 and † i. 1, Par. (also Ātm., Rām. 5, 67, 10),
 1. To think, Lass. 36, 8. To think of, with the acc., Pañc. i. d. 100; with the dat., Hariv. 5976; with the loc., Bhāg. P. 5, 19, 14; with प्रति and acc., MBh. 3, 1714.
 2. To reflect, Rām. 1, 8, 2.
 3. To mind, MBh. 3, 2399.
 4. To regard, Rām. 5, 77, 11.
 5. To devise, Hit. 13, 19. Anomalous ptcple. of the pres., छिन्तयान, Pañc. 209, 6. चिन्तित, n.
 1. Thought, Matsyop. 37.
 2. Design, Rām. 1, 70, 7.
 3. Care, Lass. 74, 17.
 --Comp.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass.
 1. Comp. अ-चिन्तनीय, Not to be thought of, Pañc. iii. d. 221.
 2. चिन्त्य, n. Necessity of minding something, Bhāg. P. 7, 5, 49.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु,
 1. To think, to think of, Hariv. 9216.
 2. To reflect, Rām. 1, 15, 23.
 3. To remember, MBh. 3, 2642.
 4. To consider, Rām. 6, 21, 35.
 --With समनु सम्-अनु,
 1. To remember, MBh. 3, 9952.
 2. To consider, MBh. 12, 12393.
 --With अभि अभि, To ponder, MBh. 13, 4341.
 --With निस् निस्, अ-निश्चिन्त्य, adj. Unfathomable, Rām. 5, 81, 6.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To reflect, MBh. 4, 1534.
 2. To remember, Rām. 5, 34, 23.
 3. To consider, MBh. 14, 568.
 4. To devise, Rām. 1, 9, 2.
 --With संपरि सम्-परि, To devise, Rām. 6, 22, 10.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To reflect, Rām. 4, 8, 8.
 2. To consider, MBh. 3, 12231.
 3. To [] devise, MBh. 3, 8820.
 --With विप्र वि-प्र, To remember, MBh. 8, 4230.
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. To remember, Rām. 5, 28, 11.
 2. To consider again, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2977.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To reflect, Pañc. 23, 10.
 2. To consider, MBh. 1, 5190.
 3. To care, Bhāg. P. 7, 2, 38.
 4. To devise, Pañc. 92, 6.
 5. To find out, MBh. 3, 1445.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass. दुर्विचिन्त्य, i. e. दुस्-, adj. Difficult to be penetrated, MBh. 12, 4628.
 --With प्रवि प्र-वि, To think of (with acc.), Rām. 5, 66, 33.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To reflect, Rām. 5, 1, 86.
 2. To consider, Pañc. 255, 3.
 3. To design, Bhāg. P. 5, 7, 1.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass. दुस्-संचिन्त्य, adj. Hardly to be imagined, Rājat. 6, 61.
 --With अनुसन् अनु-सम्, To reflect, MBh. 14, 59.
 --With अभिसम् अभि-सम्, To remember, MBh. 7, 5551.

ऽचिन्तक -चिन्त् + अक, latter part of comp. words, Thinking of, caring, e. g. MBh. 1, 7777.
 --Comp.

चिन्तन चिन्त् + अन, n.
 1. Thinking, Man. 12, 5.
 2. Way of thinking, Rājat. 5, 200.

चिन्ता चिन्त् + आ, f.
 1. Thinking, Bhāṣāp. 65.
 2. Thought, Rājat. 5, 11.
 3. Care, Pañc. i. d. 226.
 --Comp.

चिन्तामय चिन्ता + मय, adj., f. यी.
 1. Appearing as thought, Bhāg. P. 2, 2, 12.
 2. Produced by thinking, Rām. 2, 85, 16.
चिन्मात्र चिन्मात्र, i. e. चित्-मात्र, n. Pure-intelligence, Bhāg. P. 4, 7, 26.

चीन चीन, m.
 1. pl. The name of a people, Man. 10, 44.
 2. A sort of cloth, Suśr. 1, 65, 14.
 --Comp.
चीनक चीन + क, m. The name of a people = Cīna, MBh. 8, 236.
चिन्त्य- + द्योत चिन्त्य- + द्योत (vb. चिन्त्), m. a class of deities, MBh. 13, 1373.
चीन- + पट्ट चीन- + पट्ट, a sort of cloth, Kathās. 43, 89.
चिन्ता- + मणि चिन्ता- + मणि, m. a fabulous gem, the possessor of which may get all he wishes for, Hariv. 8702.
चिन्ता- + मौन चिन्ता- + मौन, n. silent thinking, Vikr. d. 130.
